notes.title: Sloth Quest Web Demo is now available on our website!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258806/21808eff4c6ce6600bf86b133b5a8f624f84dedd.pngClick Here to play Sloth Quest Demo on Lumatap.com
Requires a keyboard that can detect multiple keys held down at the same time. Typically gaming keyboards have this feature but not all office keyboards do. Alternatively the game also supports a game controller.
Please check it out and let us know what you think!
